headline: Kalebo III's own code becomes fully matched in Ratchet & Clank
summary: Kalebo III becomes Ratchet & Clank's second level with its own code fully matched (#34). PAL v2.00 rises from 54.43% to 56.30% matched code, with 3,373 of 5,109 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Small and medium implementations land across many levels alongside repairs to functions the catalogue had split apart (#30, #33).
highlights: #33 joins 72 incorrectly split functions. Some newly finished report entries are pieces counted with their owners, rather than newly written C bodies.
Kalebo III's final seven functions land with twelve implementations elsewhere (#34).
Closer unsuccessful attempts remain staged separately and do not become exact matches merely by sharing a source file with completed work.
